summary: Monro, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce the release of its sixth annual ESG report covering fiscal year 2026. The filing is a routine voluntary disclosure of corporate social responsibility initiatives, including guest experience improvements and teammate development. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. The filing does not contain any deal terms or actionable corporate action. This is a standard current report on an ESG publication, with no implications for capital structure or control.
